description: Exact-tenant actuator-playground scratch worker. Interactive `pnpm playground` records sessions and ADF drafts under active/shared/tmp/{confidential,personal}/${KYBERION_TENANT}/actuator-playground/. Writes on the tmp floor are admitted by default_allow, but child actuators and session reads need an authorized identity on that partition. This role gives the playground the same effective identity on its own tenant scratch that the claimed-WorkItem path already has — never knowledge/, other tenants, other domains on the tmp floor, staging, cache, or system floors.
